resourceBoundary.policy: Complete correlated retained layer-policy receipt or typed refusal; no document/resource payload.

semantics: Set exactly one persisted Drawing layer locked, shy or threeD flag (threeD is the baseline 3D layer switch of toggleLayer3D: it reveals Position Z, Rotation X and Rotation Y on the layer and projects it through the default camera; the row reports it while on), or (flag keyLock) the layer's standing key-lock mode: in, out, layer, or null to clear it. keyLock is read by layer-bar shifts; Missing and explicit null both read as no lock. Missing and explicit false have effectivefalse; same-effective-value edits (including clearing an absent or null keyLock) preserve field presence and add no revision/history or redo clearing. A changed flag adds one revision and one undo entry, except threeD: it is saved with a revision (applied true) but adds no history entry and leaves redo alone, as the baseline toggleLayer3D pushed no undo snapshot (the saved state rides with the last step). threeD on is refused as unavailable, with no revision, for a layer the frame path cannot place in 3D (images, text, masks, folders, effects, widgets and duplicator hosts); the document is never left unavailable by the switch. Drawing Fill alone uses the admitted lock guard; generic Motion value/track edits stay permitted. Shy is an organization flag, not global hide-mode or visibility authority. No JS/Paper writer or optimistic mutation. An optional contextId naming a declared component runs the same kernel on that component's own layers, records, frame count, order scope, holders and items (#2256, the entered component of the dense editor): the scene and the placement table stay byte-identical, one gesture is one revision and one undo entry, an undeclared context refuses not_found and a scene layer refuses typed; absent or scene-root is the scene.
